macros.name: PexaAllowBreak
macros.doc: \PexaAllowBreak Allows a line break here with a discreationary specified in the option pverb-linebreakchar= inserted.

macros.name: PexaInputSource
macros.doc: Typesets the contents of the specified file as Source in display verbatim mode.

macros.name: PexaShowBoth
macros.doc: Typeets the Source and the Sample side-by-side in display verbatim mode.

macros.name: PexaShowSample
macros.doc: Typesets the Sample (written by the last WSample or WBoth environment) in display mode.

macros.name: PexaShowSource
macros.doc: Equivalent to \PexaInputSource with the file written by the last WSource or WBoth environment.

macros.name: PVerb
macros.doc: Typesets its argument in inline verbatim mode.

macros.name: PVerbH
macros.doc: Shorthand for \PVerb[pverb-hash=half] (extra options cannot be specified).

macros.name: PVerbOpt
macros.doc: Equivalent to \PVerb, but uses a different syntax.

macros.name: Q
macros.doc: Similar to \PVerb, but its argument must be escaped (see in Subsection 3.1), and it can be used in section titles etc. Must be enabled with Q=yes.

envs.name: PexaMinipage
envs.doc: The PexaMinipage environment is provided, which is similar to the built-in minipage environment, but provides better isolation of the Sample from the container document, because it saves and restores section, page, equiation (etc.) numbers and also marks (section titles in page headers).

envs.name: PSource
envs.doc: Typesets its contents in display verbatim.

envs.name: WBoth
envs.doc: Writes its contents to the Source and the Sample temporary file.
